claim: Phrase coverage does not establish compositional visual correctness.
CLIP threshold 0.20 historically produced high realistic-negative false-positive rate, so 94.6% lenient coverage is not truth accuracy.
The post-gap-close 87.8% hard-set score is development/tuned evidence, not clean independent held-out generalization.
Wrong upstream detector boxes can create downstream semantic hallucination cascades.
Temporal persistence without explicit negative evidence can create ghost objects.
Strong priors under weak sensory evidence can increase acceptance of deliberately wrong priors.
